page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps to handle external communication and storage traffic. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given its balanced resource distribution, the ecs.g8ise.2xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications such as mid-sized web servers, enterprise application backends, containerized microservices, and development environments that require stable CPU performance and moderate memory capacity.
